Not to be confused with Timber, a Mountain Faction Rabbit.

 Timber is a  Foraging stat. It increases the chance of felling an entire tree on the first melee axe cut.

Timber Mechanics

[edit | edit source]

For every 1  Timber the player has, they gain a 1% chance to fell an entire tree on the first melee axe cut. Felling an entire tree causes the  Sweep animation to play until the tree is destroyed and a Tree Gift is rewarded. The player can still continue to cut the tree during the animation.

 Timber can be increased through various ways:

Source Type  Timber
Timber Heart of the Forest +0.1-1  Timber
 Woodpecker Shard

Helix Timber

Attribute +0.1-1  Timber on Helix Trees.
Petalfall Axe Enchantment +0.2-1 
Axed Forest Essence Shop +2%  on Axe stats.

Theoretical Maximum Timber

[edit | edit source]
  • Any Axe (+1.02 )
    • Petalfall V
    • Axed Forest Essence Shop perk
  • Heart of the Forest
    • Timber (+1 )

The maximum possible  Timber is 2.02, or with Helix Timber X is 3.02 on Helix Trees.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • It is the only Foraging Stat that isn't disabled by default on the player's Private Island.
    • Comparatively,  Bonus Pest Chance is the only Farming Stat that isn't disabled by default on the player's Private Island.
  •  Speed,  Attack Speed,  Ferocity,  Swing Range,  Mining Spread,  Gemstone Spread,  Timber,  Fishing Speed,  Trophy Chance,  Treasure Chance,  Magic Find and ❣ Charm Chance are the only stats with a cap.
